questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Microsoft Purview: a Purview capability for understanding how data moves and transforms across systems.
Sensitive data classification: an individual Azure Policy rule that describes a desired or prohibited resource condition.
Automated data discovery: a Purview capability that helps identify data across the data estate.
Microsoft Purview: a family of data governance, risk, and compliance solutions that provides a unified view of data across environments.
Automated data discovery: a view that helps organizations understand where data is stored and how it is classified.

questions.question: Which TWO statements accurately reflect the concepts covered in this unit?

options.text: End-to-end data lineage: a Purview capability for understanding how data moves and transforms across systems.
End-to-end data lineage: a service for creating, assigning, and managing rules that audit or control Azure resource configurations.
Sensitive data classification: Purview capabilities for mapping, classifying, discovering, and governing data across on-premises, multicloud, and SaaS sources.
Sensitive data classification: a Purview capability for identifying and classifying sensitive information.
End-to-end data lineage: a collection of related Azure Policy definitions grouped to support a broader compliance goal.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Sensitive data classification — a Purview capability for identifying and classifying sensitive information; and End-to-end data lineage — a Purview capability for understanding how data moves and transforms across systems.
